lead: A tree-wide `--record-perf --force` can fail a flat bench as `grows`.
body: Under load the clock trips twice, callgrind then runs at the small batches a lowered N leaves, and its instructions can read as rising there: `Core\IO\File::seek` and `Core\Response::json` both did, and both pass re-recorded alone. Re-record a `grows` finding from a long sweep with `--only <id>` on a quiet machine before treating it as real, since `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` runs callgrind whenever the clock grows twice.
